visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a black t-shirt is positioned centrally against a plain, lavender-colored wall. He holds a large, square pink box with the brand name hince embossed on it. His facial expression is animated, mouth open as if speaking, looking directly into the camera lens with bright studio lighting illuminating his face. (2) He places the box down and opens it, leaning forward into the frame to reveal a clear, circular palette containing several small, egg-shaped makeup containers in various shades of pink and red. His hands are active, reaching inside the box to adjust the products while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (3) He removes the transparent circular lid away from the palette. A small green dinosaur cartoon graphic appears in the bottom right corner for a second. He points towards the specific balm products with his index finger. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame consistently. (4) The camera shot size shifts to a medium close-up focusing on a single pink, egg-shaped balm held in his right hand. He unscrews the top to show the glossy pink product inside. He then swipes the product onto his left forearm, which has a distinct black band tattoo. (5) A fast-cut editing sequence shows multiple color swatches appearing on his forearm. Six distinct glossy streaks ranging from light peach to deep plum are visible. Text labels for each product color appear next to the swatches on the screen. He gestures toward the arm excitedly. (6) Returning to a medium close-up of his face, he holds a dark pink balm and uses a small application brush to apply it to his lower lip. He looks into the camera, tilting his head slightly to catch the light. The application process is shown clearly with the glossy product. (7) He holds a translucent blue-tinted balm and applies it as a top coat over the first color on his lips. He then presses his lips together, pouting and smiling to demonstrate the high-shine, non-sticky finish. He continues talking with expressive hand gestures until the video fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Unboxing -> Swatch demonstration -> On-face application -> Texture testing -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote and review a new line of egg-shaped lip and cheek balms from the brand 'hince'. Through an energetic unboxing and step-by-step demonstration including arm swatches and direct application, the creator highlights the product's vibrant colors and non-sticky, glossy texture to encourage viewers to purchase the set.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator opens a branded box, demonstrates every shade in the collection, and gives a direct positive recommendation for the brand's new items.
